intro: PERU WONDERS TOURS is a Peruvian travel agency dedicated to creating unforgettable travel experiences throughout Peru.

We specialize in cultural, historical, archaeological and adventure tours, offering personalized services designed to connect travelers with the beauty, traditions and fascinating history of our country.
Our commitment is to provide quality service, personalized attention and memorable experiences, helping every traveler discover the true wonders of Peru.
mission: To provide authentic, safe and memorable travel experiences in Peru through personalized tourism services, professional attention and a strong commitment to customer satisfaction and sustainable tourism.
vision: To become a recognized Peruvian travel agency in the international tourism market, distinguished by the quality of our services, personalized attention and our passion for showcasing the cultural and natural treasures of Peru.
